The FERC New England transmission base-ROE outcome, now on a hard clock - FERC's Section 205 paper hearing sets a prospective rate effective November 30, 2026 against ES's 11.39% refiling, with a DC Circuit stay petition pending and ~$880M of incremental refund exposure unbooked ("refund the incremental $880 million, we would do that in a balanced manner." 2026Q2); it decides whether the rebased 5-7% algorithm holds or gets cut a second time. The Aquarion corollary is RETIRED (closed June 30, $1.7B net, above the ~$1.6B assumed); its replacement is the CL&P rate case filed July 14 ($451
